verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of an official SDK is a pricing-page line listing a "Mobile SDK" as a paid add-on; a REST Web API is also documented, but a raw API is not an SDK. Nothing in the pack describes the SDK's languages, platforms, documentation depth, or how it fits AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: documented SDK scope (languages and platforms), SDK reference docs or guides, SDKs beyond mobile (e.g. server or Web API client libraries), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.
